blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: We introduce StructuralCost , a self-paced reading dataset of 475 participants and 40 , 800 40,800 observations isolating the processing cost of long-distance subject-verb dependency resolution. We replicate a low-powered psycholinguistic finding at NLP scale, namely that human reading times at the main verb increase with dependency length, driven by syntactic embedding beyond linear distance. Different language models – spanning n n -gram models, SSMs, and transformers – partially mirror this graded difficulty profile, yet underestimate the integration cost humans incur, with a gap that persists across architectures and model sizes. This suggests these models capture the predictive component of human processing but not the full integration cost that working memory imposes. StructuralCost provides data needed to drive progress toward evaluating the cognitive plausibility of language models.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了结构成本(Structural Cost),一个由475名参与者和40,800,40,800名观测结果组成的自速读取数据集,隔离了长途主题-动词依赖分辨率的处理成本. 我们在NLP尺度上复制了一种低功率的心理语言学发现,即人类主动词的读取时间随着依赖长度而增加,由线性距离外的合成嵌入所驱动. 不同的语言模型 — — 跨越n-gram模型,SSM,以及变压器 — — 部分地反映了这种分级难度剖面,然而低估了人类所承受的集成成本,在建筑和模型大小之间仍然存在差距. 这表明这些模型能够捕捉人类加工的预测成分,但不能捕捉工作记忆带来的全部集成成本. 结构 成本提供所需的数据,以推动在评估语言模型的认知可信性方面取得进展。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: An actively debated question in computational psycholinguistics is whether language models (LMs) can serve as computational models of human sentence processing ( Wilcox et al., 2020 ; Oh and Schuler, 2023 ) ; essentially, whether the mechanisms driving LMs’ text processing mirror those humans deploy during language comprehension. The question has practical stakes: a cognitively plausible LM could be used to test hypotheses at scale that are otherwise difficult or impossible to probe experimentally and to leverage model failures to sharpen sentence processing theories.
blocks.zh: 计算心理语言学中一个激烈争论的问题是,语言模型(LMs)是否能够作为人类判决处理的计算模型(Wilcox等人,2020年;Oh和Schuler,2023年);基本上,驱动LMs文本处理的机制是否与那些在语言理解过程中被部署的人相仿. 这个问题有实际的利害关系:一种认知上可信的LM可以用来测试规模上的假设,这些假设本来是难以或不可能进行实验探索的,并用来利用模型故障来磨练句子处理理论.

blocks.en: Language comprehension is incremental and constrained by two key components: prediction and working memory. As readers encounter each word, they continuously predict what comes next, and processing effort rises when those predictions fail ( Hale, 2001 ; Levy, 2008 ) . At the same time, comprehension relies on working memory, which temporarily hold syntactic information until it can be integrated ( Gibson, 2001 ; Lewis et al., 2006 ) , e.g., the subject of a sentence remains active in memory until its main verb is later encountered.
blocks.zh: 语言理解是递增的,受到预测和工作记忆两个关键组成部分的限制. 当读者遇到每个词时,他们不断地预测接下来会发生什么,当这些预测失败时,处理工作就会增加(Hale,2001;Levy,2008.). 同时,理解依赖于工作记忆,工作记忆暂时持有合成信息直到能够被整合(Gibson,2001;Lewis等,2006.),例如,句子的主题在记忆中仍然活跃,直到后来遇到其主要动词.

blocks.en:
LMs assign probabilities to words in context, which are a natural proxy for simulating the predictive component of human language processing. Numerous studies show that the surprisal of models, a simple log-transformation of these probabilities, correlates reliably with reading times – the primary behavioral proxy for online cognitive effort in psycholinguistics (e.g., Smith and Levy, 2013 ; Goodkind and Bicknell, 2018 ; Futrell et al., 2021 ).
However, surprisal fit alone does not reveal whether LMs capture the memory-based component of language processing, one of its key signatures being the cost of resolving long dependencies: the further apart a syntactic head and its dependent are, the greater the cognitive effort required to resolve that dependency ( Gibson, 2001 ; Lewis et al., 2006 ) . This is a theoretically important distinction: LM architectures differ greatly in how they handle distance, from n n -gram models with a hard local window to transformers with unconstrained self-attention. Thus, evaluating whether LMs replicate the graded effect of dependency length is a direct test of cognitive plausibility.
blocks.zh:
LMS为上下文中的单词分配概率,这是模拟人类语言处理的预测成分的自然代名词. 众多研究表明,模型的外观,即这些概率的简单对数转换,与阅读时间——心理语言学中在线认知努力的主要行为代名词——有着可靠的关联(例如:Smith and Levy,2013;Goodkind and Bicknell,2018;Futrell等人,2021年).
然而,仅靠优势并不能说明LMS是否抓住语言处理中基于内存的部分,其关键签名之一是解决长期依赖性的成本:一个合成头和它的依赖性越相隔开,解决这种依赖性所需的认知努力就越多(Gibson,2001;Lewis等,2006)。 这是一个理论上重要的区分:LM架构在如何处理距离上有很大的不同,从有硬本地窗口的n-gram模型到无约束自注的变压器. 因此,评估LMS是否复制了依赖长度的分级效应是对认知可信度的直接考验.

blocks.en: Measuring this graded difficulty profile is inherently challenging, as it requires isolating the impact of syntactic structure from confounding lexical factors, such as word frequency and length, which also influence processing times ( Oh et al., 2024 ) . Large naturalistic corpora provide the necessary scale for model evaluation but are often confounded by these lexical variables, making it difficult to separate the effects of dependency length from other influences. On the other hand, controlled psycholinguistic experiments are effective at isolating structural effects but typically lack the scale needed to evaluate models comprehensively. No existing dataset successfully combines both experimental control and large-scale data. To fill this gap, we introduce StructuralCost , a manually curated dataset of 40 , 800 40,800 self-paced reading observations from 475 475 participants, including individual working memory scores. 1 1 1 StructuralCost is available at https://doi.org/10.34847/nkl.7c467lyv . Experiment: https://github.com/NinaNusb/Self-paced-reading-task . Analysis: https://github.com/NinaNusb/lm-human-processing.git . StructuralCost is built following psycholinguistic standards applied at NLP scale: it holds the main subject-verb pair constant while systematically varying the distance between them, isolating the processing cost of dependency length from lexical confounds.
blocks.zh: 衡量这种分级难度剖面具有固有的挑战性,因为它要求将综合结构的影响与混淆的词汇因素相分离,例如词频和长度,这也影响了处理时间(Oh等,2024年). 大型自然结构为模型评价提供了必要的尺度,但往往被这些词汇变量所混淆,因此难以将依赖长度的影响与其他影响区分开来. 另一方面,受控制的心理语言学实验在隔离结构效应方面是有效的,但通常缺乏全面评价模型所需的尺度。 没有现有的数据集成功结合了实验控制和大规模数据. 为了填补这一空白,我们引入了结构成本(Structural Cost),这是一个人工整理的数据集,由475,475名参与者的40,800,40,800个自速读取观测数据,包括个人工作记忆分数. 1 1 结构成本可在https://doi.org/10.34847/nkl. 7c467lyv查询。 实验:https://github.com/NinaNusb/自发-节奏-读取-任务. 分析:https://github.com/NinaNusb/lm-human-procession.git. 互联网档案馆的存檔,存档日期2013-12-21. 结构Cost是按照NLP尺度应用的心理语言标准所构建的:它持有主体-动词对相常数,同时系统地改变它们之间的距离,将依赖长度的处理成本与词汇混乱相隔离.

blocks.en: Using StructuralCost , we show that reading times at the main verb increase with dependency length – an effect driven by syntactic depth beyond linear distance alone – and that existing LMs only partially mirror this graded difficulty profile despite achieving strong global surprisal-RT fit. Models tend to underestimate the integration cost humans incur, consistently across architectures and model sizes, pointing to a fundamental limitation for treating them as plausible mechanistic models of sentence comprehension: current LMs seem to capture the predictive component of human processing but not the memory-based integration cost.
blocks.zh: 使用结构Cost,我们显示主动词的读取时间随依赖长度而增加 — — 这一效应是由单线外距离的合成深度驱动的 — — 而现有的LMs仅仅部分地反映了这种分级难度配置,尽管实现了强大的全球外接-RT相配. 模型往往低估人类在各种建筑和模型规模中不断发生的融合成本,指出将人视为合理理解句子的机械模型的根本局限性:目前的LM似乎抓住了人类加工的预测部分,而不是基于记忆的融合成本。

blocks.en:
Our contributions are threefold:
(1) we release StructuralCost , a large-scale controlled dataset that isolates dependency length effects on human reading times, replicating at large-scale previously low-powered psycholinguistic findings; StructuralCost is a controlled diagnostic tool, targeting a specific phenomenon, and not a general benchmark; this limited scope is a design choice, not a limitation. The use of established measures (surprisal-RT alignment, mixed models) is deliberate, so that the results remain directly comparable to existing psycholinguistic and NLP resources, the novelty being in the resource and its controlled manipulation.
(2) In this controlled context, we observe that syntactic structure beyond mere linear distance modulates processing difficulty.
(3) We observe that current LMs, across architectures and sizes, only partially replicate this graded difficulty profile despite strong global surprisal-RT fit, revealing a systematic blind spot in how cognitive plausibility is evaluated. We argue this motivates a shift toward controlled, memory-sensitive datasets as a criterion for cognitive plausibility.
blocks.zh:
我们的贡献有三:
(1)我们发布结构Cost(Structure Cost),一个大规模可控数据集,它隔离了对人类阅读时间的依赖长度效应,在大规模上复制之前低能的心理语言学发现; 结构Cost(Structure Cost)是一个可控的诊断工具,针对特定现象,而不是一般的基准; 这个有限的范围是一个设计选择,而不是限制. 采用既定措施(补充-RT配对、混合模式)是故意的,其结果与现有的心理语言和NLP资源保持直接可比性,资源中的新颖之处及其控制的操纵。
(2)在这个被控制的上下文中,我们观察到,超出单纯线性距离的合成结构会调节处理难度.
(3) 我们观察到,目前的LMS,在建筑和大小上,尽管具有强大的全球超前-RT适切性,但只是部分复制这种分级难度剖面,揭示了认知可信度如何评价的系统性盲点. 我们认为,这促使人们转向有控制的、对内存敏感的数据集,作为认知可信度的标准。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Because LMs assign probabilities to words in context, their surprisal estimates, defined as − log 2 ⁡ p ⁡ ( word | context ) -\log_{2}p(\textrm{word}|\textrm{context}) , are a natural proxy for the predictive component of human language processing, and a growing body of work confirms they correlate with human reading times ( Goodkind and Bicknell, 2018 ; Futrell et al., 2021 ) . However, recent work finds an inverse scaling trend: larger models do not always yield better psychometric fit ( Oh et al., 2022 ; Oh and Schuler, 2023 ; Shain et al., 2024 ) , likely because state-of-the-art models have become superhuman at next-word prediction ( Oh and Linzen, 2025 ) , causing their surprisal to underestimate the difficulty humans experience.
blocks.zh: 由于LMS在上下文中指定了词的概率,所以其附加估计被定义为-log 2 ⁡ p ⁡ ( word  word  word ( word  word |)-\log_{2}p (\textrm{word}|\textrm{context}),是人类语言处理的预测成分的自然代名词,而越来越多的工作证实了它们与人类阅读时间的关联(Goodkind and Bicknell, 2018; Futrell等, 2021). 然而,近期的作品发现一个反向缩放趋势:更大的模型并不总是产生更好的心理测量相合性(Oh等,2022;Oh和Schuler等,2023;Shain等,2024),可能是因为最先进的模型在下个字预测(Oh和Linzen,2025)时成为了超人,导致其超人低估了人类经历的困难.

blocks.en: A parallel line of work asks whether architectural constraints can bring models closer to human behavior. De Varda and Marelli (2024) and Timkey and Linzen (2023) show that inductive biases, beyond raw prediction accuracy, shape psychometric fit. Kuribayashi et al. (2022) provide a mechanistic explanation: transformer self-attention gives equal weight to all prior context, removing the distance-dependent decay that produces locality effects in human processing. They show that imposing context limitations on transformers partially restores these effects.
blocks.zh: 一个平行的工作线询问建筑限制能否使模型更接近人类的行为. De Varda和Marelli(2024年),Timkey和Linzen(2023年)表明,超出原始预测准确度的诱导偏差,形状心理测量适中. Kuribayashi等人(2022年)提供了一种机械化的解释:变压器自觉给予所有之前的上下文同等的分量,去除了在人类加工中产生局部效应的距离依赖衰变. 它们表明,对变压器施加上下文限制部分地恢复了这些效果.

blocks.en: However, these constrained models have been evaluated primarily on reaction times from naturalistic datasets: Dundee Kennedy and Pynte (2005) , Provo Luke and Christianson (2018) , MECO Siegelman et al. (2022) , UCL Frank et al. (2013) , the SPR Brown corpus Smith and Levy (2013) , and Natural Stories Futrell et al. (2021) 2 2 2 Except Timkey and Linzen , who studied disambiguation. . While these corpora provide valuable insights into the global ability of LMs to fit general behavioral predictability, the uncontrolled variability in naturalistic data – where frequency, length, and syntactic structure are confounded – makes these datasets less well suited for modeling processing cost arising from structural complexity. Therefore, to be able to evaluate the cognitive plausibility of LMs, we must move beyond global fit on natural text and adopt controlled datasets that systematically manipulate structural and memory demands.
blocks.zh: 然而,这些受限模型主要根据自然数据集的反应时间进行评估: Dundee Kennedy和Pynte(2005年)、Provo Luke和Christianson(2018年)、MECO Siegelman等(2022年),UCL Frank等人(2013年)、SPR Brownectors Smith和Levy(2013年),以及Natural Stories Futrell等人(2021年) 2 2 2 除了Timkey和Linzen之外,他们研究了歧义。 虽然这些公司提供了对LMS适应一般行为可预测性的全球能力的宝贵见解,但自然学数据的无节制可变性 — — 其频率、长度和合成结构都令人困惑 — — 使得这些数据集不太适合用于结构复杂性产生的模型处理成本。 因此,为了能够评价LMs的认知可信度,我们必须超越全球自然文本,采用控制数据集,系统地操纵结构和记忆需求。

blocks.en:
Evaluating the cognitive plausibility of LMs involves testing their sensitivity to structural effects alongside their general ability to predict reading times. We identify four criteria that, we argue, datasets must satisfy to support such evaluation: (C1) Isolation – sentences must appear in isolation to remove the influence of prior context and focus solely on working memory limits; (C2) Controlled variables – the dataset must systematically vary dependency length while keeping vocabulary and lexical properties constant, ensuring that any increase in difficulty is due to memory load, not harder words; (C3) Sufficient items – a broad and varied set of unique sentences to provide robust model evaluation; (C4) Sufficient participants – enough participants per sentence to ensure reliable statistical estimates.
Existing resources are insufficient for the evaluation of LMs’ potential sensitivity to structural complexity as neither meets all three criteria: NLP-oriented datasets offer large-scale naturalistic data but lack experimental control to isolate structural effects, while psycholinguistic datasets provide strong control but lack the items and participants needed for model evaluation. StructuralCost is designed to satisfy all criteria simultaneously (see Appendix A for a detailed evaluation of existing datasets against these criteria).
blocks.zh:
评估LMs的认知可信性涉及测试其对结构效应的敏感性以及预测阅读时间的一般能力。 我们提出,数据集必须满足支持这种评价的四个标准:(C1) 孤立 – 必须孤立地出现句子来去除先前上下文的影响并只注重工作内存限制;(C2) 被控制的变量 – 数据集必须系统地改变依赖长度,同时保持词汇和词典属性不变,确保任何难度的增加都出自内存负载,而不是更硬的词; (C3) 充足的项目 — 广泛而多样的一组独特的句子来提供强健的模型评价;(C4) 足够的参与者 — 每句有足够的参与者来保证可靠的统计估计.
现有资源不足以评价LMS对结构复杂性的潜在敏感性,因为既不满足所有三项标准:面向NLP的数据集提供大规模自然学数据,但缺乏实验控制以隔离结构效应,而心理语言数据集则提供强大的控制,但缺乏模型评价所需的项目和参与者. 结构成本旨在同时满足所有标准(关于对照这些标准对现有数据集的详细评价,见附录A)。

blocks.en: 3 Dataset Creation
blocks.zh: 3 数据集创建

blocks.en: Our dataset targets a well-documented prediction from memory-based theories of sentence processing: longer dependencies between a subject and a verb yield higher integration costs at the verb ( Gibson, 2001 ; Lewis et al., 2006 ) . To isolate this effect, we contrast sentences that have maximally overlapping vocabulary but varying distance between the main subject and main verb, which we manipulate using intervening material. 3 3 3 We focus on English, whose relative clause and center-embedding structures are well-documented in the psycholinguistic literature, providing robust predictions against which to evaluate model behavior.
blocks.zh: 我们的数据集旨在从基于内存的句子处理理论中作出一个有充分记录的预测:一个主体和一个动词之间较长的依赖性在动词上产生更高的集成成本(Gibson,2001;Lewis等,2006.). 为了孤立这种效果,我们对比了那些词句,这些词句词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词和词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词和词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词和词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词词 3 3 3 我们专注于英语,英语的相对条款和中嵌入结构在心理语言学文献中都有详细记载,提供了有力的预测,用以评价模型行为.

blocks.en: Dependency length can increase in two ways: linearly, by inserting prepositional phrases or also hierarchically, by embedding relative clauses. Both increase subject-verb distance, but differ in processing demands: linear modifications incrementally extend dependencies, while hierarchical embeddings introduce qualitatively greater complexity by nesting clauses and requiring the reader to manage multiple layers of syntactic information, increasing storage cost on working memory ( Gibson, 2001 ; Liu et al., 2026 ) , though see Section 6 for an unexpected reversal of this prediction at double embedding. Structural complexity may also contribute independently of dependency length: object relative clauses are consistently harder than subject ones even at matched distances ( Gordon et al., 2001 ) . Individual differences in working memory capacity (WMC) may further modulate these effects, with lower-WMC readers showing larger slowdowns under long-distance dependencies ( King and Just, 1991 ; Just and Carpenter, 1992 ) . The controlled structure of our design allows us to tease apart these potentially confounded factors, through two sentence types: critical sentences and control sentences .
blocks.zh: 依赖长度可以有两种方式来增加:线性地,通过插入前置短语或者也通过分级地,嵌入相对条款. 两者都增加了主题-动词相距,但在处理需求上却有所不同:线性修改递增地延伸了依赖性,而分级嵌入则通过嵌入条款和要求读者管理多层的合成信息,在工作内存上增加了存储成本(Gibson,2001;Liu等,2026),虽然在双嵌入时意外地扭转了这一预测,但从质量上来说更为复杂. 结构复杂程度也可能独立于依赖时间:即使相距相近,物体相对条款也始终比主题条款更难(Gordon等人,2001年)。 个人在工作记忆能力(WMC)方面的差异可能进一步改变这些效果,而较低层次的WMC读者在长途依赖性下显示的减速较大(King and Just,1991;Just and Carpenter,1992.). 我们设计的受控结构使我们能够通过两种句子——关键句子和控制句子——来取笑这些潜在的困惑因素。

blocks.en: Critical sentences are of primary interest: they manipulate syntactic structure while keeping dependency length constant across conditions. The intervening material between subject and verb is either a subject relative clause (SRC) or an object relative clause (ORC), singly embedded (4-word dependency) or doubly embedded (9-word dependency), yielding four core conditions. Two additional conditions anchor the design: a 0-word dependency baseline with no intervening material, and a prepositional phrase (PP) condition at 4 words. The PP condition is critical to the logic of the design: it matches the singly embedded relatives in surface dependency length while introducing no additional clause (i.e., no embedded subject and verb) between subject and verb, isolating linear distance as a factor independently of clausal embedding. Critical items thus comprise six conditions in total (an example set is shown in Table 1 ).
blocks.zh: 关键句子具有首要意义:它们操纵合成结构,同时在各种条件下保持依赖长度不变. 主体和动词之间的干涉材料要么是一个主题相对条款(SRC),要么是一个对象相对条款(ORC),单独嵌入(4个字依赖)或双嵌入(9个字依赖),产生四个核心条件. 两个附加条件支撑了设计:一个是0字依赖基线,没有干涉材料;一个是4字的预置短语(PP)条件. PP条件对设计逻辑至关重要:它与表面依赖长度中被单嵌入的亲缘关系相匹配,同时在主体和动词之间不引入附加条款(即没有嵌入主体和动词),将线性距离隔离为独立于幽闭嵌入的一个因素. 因此,关键项目共包括6个条件(一个实例见表1)。

blocks.en: Control sentences extend the linear distance manipulation introduced by the PP condition in the critical items. They augment dependency length through prepositional phrases of increasing length (0, 4, and 9 words), without embedding an additional clause; an example set can be seen in Table 1 . Matched to critical items on dependency length but not hierarchical complexity, they allow direct dissociation of linear distance from structural depth effects, with the PP conditions serving as the common reference point between the two sets.
blocks.zh: 控制句会延长PP条件在关键项目中引入的线性距离操纵. 它们通过增加长度(0个、4个和9个字)的预置短语来增加依赖时间,而不插入一个补充条款;一个实例集见表1。 与依赖长度但不属于等级复杂性的关键项目相匹配,它们允许线性距离与结构深度效应直接分离,由PP条件作为两套之间共同的参考点.

blocks.en: Sentences were generated with LLaMA-3.2 ( Grattafiori et al., 2024 ) and Perplexity.ai ( 2024 ) under tight constraints (identical subject-verb pairs, minimal lexical variation, semantic plausibility), then manually reviewed and extensively corrected for naturalness. Complete construction details (constraints, correction criteria, and item statistics) are provided in Appendix B . LLM output served only as an initial drafting aid to vary semantic domains while preserving structural consistency across conditions; final acceptance required independent manual judgments of plausibility, semantic equivalence, and naturalness across all six condition-mates in a set. The final dataset comprises 60 60 sentences per condition across the six critical item conditions ( 360 360 sentences total) and 30 30 sentences per condition across the three control conditions ( 90 90 sentences total), for a grand total of 450 450 sentences. 4 4 4 Sentences were matched in length ( 13 13 – 15 15 words) to prevent reading-strategy differences across conditions, since RTs were collected via non-cumulative moving-window self-paced reading. Shorter sentences were extended to match the double-embedded ones by appending a coordinated clause in the post-critical region.
blocks.zh: LLaMA-3.2(Grattafiori等,2024年)和Perplexity.ai(2024年)在严格的限制下(同同题动词对等,最小的字法变异,语义上的合理性)生成了句子,然后对自然性进行了手动审查和广泛的纠正. 完整的建筑细节(限制、校正标准和项目统计)载于附录B。 LLM输出仅作为最初的起草辅助工具,用于改变语义域,同时保持不同条件的结构一致性;最终接受需要独立手工判断一组所有六个条件伴侣的可信度、语义等同性和自然性。 最终数据集包括6个关键项目条件中的每个条件60个判决(共计360 360个判决)和3个控制条件中的每个条件30个判决(共计90 90个判决),共计450 450个判决。 4 4 4 句子的长度相匹配(13个13个-15个15个字),以防止各种条件的读取策略差异,因为RT是通过非累积的移动-窗口自发的读取来收集的. 延长了较短的刑期,以便与双重刑期相匹配,办法是在后关键地区附加一个协调条款。

blocks.en: Reading times were collected from native English speakers recruited via Prolific, an online crowdsourcing platform widely used in cognitive research, and using a self-paced reading (SPR) procedure. Participants read one list of 90 counterbalanced sentences (details in Appendix B ); comprehension was verified using manually curated comprehension questions and only participations with a score ≥ \geq 70 % 70\text{\,}\mathrm{\%} were kept, yielding a total of 475 475 participants. Sentences with word reading times below 100 ms 100\text{\,}\mathrm{ms} or above 3 , 000 ms 3,000\text{\,}\mathrm{ms} are excluded from the dataset as likely reflecting inattention or technical errors (< 5 % 5\text{\,}\mathrm{\%} of the data), yielding a final dataset of 27 , 103 27,103 critical sentences and 13 , 663 13,663 control sentences. After the reading task, participants performed a working memory capacity test using the operation span test. Full participant details, exclusion criteria, task parameters, participant instructions, consent procedure, and recruitment details are provided in the Datasheet in Appendix B .

blocks.en: Before examining the ability of LMs to predict reading times, we first report a series of control tests to assess the quality of the collected data, where we observe that human reading times follow the patterns described by sentence processing theories. We apply a Region of Practical Equivalence (ROPE) analysis, comparing RTs between different sentence groups and considering differences smaller than 0.1 0.1 SD of the RT distribution ( 35 ms 35\text{\,}\mathrm{ms} in our data) as negligible. This helps us determine whether the observed differences are meaningful, rather than merely detectable due to our large sample size.
blocks.zh: 在检查LMS预测读取时间的能力之前,我们首先报告了一系列控制测试,以评估所收集的数据的质量,我们观察到人类的读取时间遵循了句子处理理论所描述的规律. 我们采用了实用等效区域分析法,比较不同句子组的RT, 将RT分布中小于0.1 SD(35 mss 35\text\,}\mathrm{ms}在我们的数据中)的差异视为可忽略不计。 这有助于我们确定所观测到的差异是否有意义,而不是仅仅由于我们的样本规模大而可以察觉。

blocks.en: We first observe the effect of dependency length on verb reading times, collapsing across clause types. Reading times increase from 0-word ( M = 490 ms M=$490\text{\,}\mathrm{ms}$ ) to 4-word dependencies ( M = 544 ms M=$544\text{\,}\mathrm{ms}$ ), and decrease slightly at 9 words ( M = 528 ms M=$528\text{\,}\mathrm{ms}$ ). This pattern aligns partially with sentence processing theories, which argue that longer dependencies lead to higher processing costs, but already suggests that distance alone does not drive difficulty: the ROPE analysis confirms that both the 0- vs. 4-word ( d = − 0.15 d=-0.15 , 95 % 95\text{\,}\mathrm{\%} CI [ − 0.19 , − 0.12 ] [-0.19,-0.12] ) and 0- vs. 9-word contrasts ( d = − 0.11 d=-0.11 , 95 % 95\text{\,}\mathrm{\%} CI [ − 0.15 , − 0.08 ] [-0.15,-0.08] ) exceed the ROPE, while the 4- vs. 9-word contrast is negligible ( d = 0.05 d=0.05 , 95 % 95\text{\,}\mathrm{\%} CI [ 0.02 , 0.07 ] [0.02,0.07] ). Collapsing across clause types, however, confounds distance with syntactic structure, so we turn to condition-level comparisons to investigate the impact of syntactic structure on processing difficulty.

All conditions slow readers down relative to baseline, but to varying degrees (Table 2 ). Crucially, at the same 4-word dependency length, the three conditions pattern differently: the PP produces a negligible effect relative to the ROPE ( d = − 0.08 d=-0.08 , 95 % 95\text{\,}\mathrm{\%} CI [ − 0.12 , − 0.04 ] [-0.12,-0.04] ), the SRC a small but meaningful one ( d = − 0.15 d=-0.15 , 95 % 95\text{\,}\mathrm{\%} CI [ − 0.19 , − 0.12 ] [-0.19,-0.12] ), and the ORC the largest one ( d = − 0.19 d=-0.19 , 95 % 95\text{\,}\mathrm{\%} CI [ − 0.24 , − 0.15 ] [-0.24,-0.15] ). That three conditions sharing identical dependency length produce graded slowdowns suggests that the structural source of the dependency contributes to processing difficulty independently of its surface length. At 9-word dependencies, the same ordering holds: 2 × \times SRC ( d = − 0.11 d=-0.11 , 95 % 95\text{\,}\mathrm{\%} CI [ − 0.15 , − 0.08 ] [-0.15,-0.08] ) is slower than baseline but faster than 2 × \times ORC ( d = − 0.14 d=-0.14 , 95 % 95\text{\,}\mathrm{\%} CI [ − 0.18 , − 0.10 ] [-0.18,-0.10] ). blocks.en: To situate StructuralCost against related resources with less control, we fit the same model M1 to Natural Stories Futrell et al. (2021) and UCL-SPR Frank et al. (2013) at the integration site of the main verb and report the resulting fixed-effect coefficients in Figure 2 (implementation details in Appendix D ). The dependency length effect decreases at the main verb in both naturalistic corpora, while it increases in StructuralCost . Back-transforming from an example 500 ms 500\text{\,}\mathrm{ms} baseline, this corresponds to a ∼ \sim 1–5ms difference per SD of dependency length in naturalistic datasets versus ∼ \sim 11 ms 11\text{\,}\mathrm{ms} in StructuralCost – a difference our controlled design can isolate because dependency length is varied orthogonally to lexical properties. blocks.en: 5 Probing Surprisal as a Cognitive Proxy
blocks.zh: 5作为认知代用品的Surprisal

blocks.en: We evaluate the extent to which LM surprisal captures the graded cost of integrating a subject with its verb across an intervening dependency as opposed to surface-level predictability. This requires dissociating two levels of alignment, which we term global and local .
blocks.zh: 我们评价了LM 上层在多大程度上掌握了将一个主题与它所影响的动词结合到一个中间的依赖性,而不是表面的可预测性的分级成本。 这就需要将我们称之为全球和地方的两级协调分开。

blocks.en:
Global alignment asks whether surprisal correlates with RTs across all word positions.
This is a meaningful and well-established result ( Smith and Levy, 2013 ) , but a weak test of cognitive plausibility: a model that has learned general word frequency and co-occurrence statistics will score well here, because most RT variance reflects lexical predictability rather than structural cost. Global alignment is therefore a necessary baseline but is not enough to model human processing: averaging over all
positions dilutes the structural signal present at the main verb, which we evaluate separately as local alignment.
blocks.zh:
全球协调询问,在所有文字位置上,追加资源是否与RT相关。
这是一个有意义和既定的结果(Smith and Levy, 2013),但对认知可信度的微弱测试:一个学习了一般词频和共发性统计的模型会在这里得到很好的分数,因为大多数RT差异都反映了词汇的可预测性而不是结构成本. 因此,全球协调统一是一个必要的基线,但不足以模拟人类加工:
位置会淡化主动词中存在的结构信号,我们分别评价为局部对齐.

blocks.en: Local alignment measures the same correlation restricted to a theoretically motivated position: the main verb, where the subject-verb dependency is resolved and humans show graded difficulty as a function of dependency length and syntactic structure. This is a much stricter test: fitting RTs well requires assigning higher surprisal when the dependency is harder to integrate, a sensitivity to structural cost that goes beyond surface statistics. A model that passes the global test but fails the local one has learned lexical predictability without encoding the memory-based integration cost that drives human processing difficulty.

blocks.en: We selected models spanning a memory constraint spectrum: two KenLM n n -gram models Heafield (2011) 8 8 8 Trained on WikiText-103, tokenized with gpt-2 and pythia tokenizers. as a Markovian baseline with a hard local window of 5 tokens; three gpt-2 models (small, large, XL; Radford et al., 2019 ) and three pythia models (70M, 1.4B, 12B; Biderman et al., 2023 ) as representatives of the currently dominant transformer architecture with unconstrained self-attention; and three mamba models (130M, 1.4B, 2.8B; Gu and Dao, 2024 ) implementing selective state-space compression as a proxy for recency-biased memory and incremental recurrent processing at scale. Within each family, size variation tests whether scaling improves behavioral fit while controlling for training data and vocabulary.

blocks.en: We assess alignment between model surprisal and human RTs using two complementary methods. The first captures broad co-variation: for each word position, we compute Spearman correlations between model surprisal and mean RT across participants, evaluated both globally (all positions) and locally (main verb only). The second tests whether surprisal contributes independently of known low-level predictors: we fit a sequence of nested linear mixed-effects models ( Bates, 2010 ) predicting log RT for each word read by each participant, adding predictors incrementally to isolate the unique contribution of surprisal and dependency length:
blocks.zh: 我们使用两种互补方法评估模型超常和人类RT的一致性。 第一种捕捉到广义的共变:对于每个单词位置,我们计算模型上方和参与者平均RT之间的斯皮尔曼关联,同时评价全球(所有位置)和地方(只有主动词). 第二次测试实验是否独立于已知的低水平预测器: 我们搭配了一组嵌入式线性混合效应模型(Bates,2010年) 预测每个参与者读取的每个单词的对数RT, 并递增地添加了预测器,以隔离实验和依赖长度的独特贡献:

blocks.en: 5.2 Results
blocks.zh: 5.2 结果

blocks.en: We first establish whether LM surprisal predicts human RTs across all word positions, replicating prior work and setting a baseline against which local alignment can be assessed. Spearman correlations with word-level RTs are moderate and strikingly uniform: all models cluster at r = 0.51 r=0.51 – 0.53 0.53 with tight CIs ( ± .02 \pm.02 ) far from zero (Figure 3 , left panel), regardless of architecture or size. The mixed-effects analysis confirms this picture: adding surprisal to the baseline model improves fit for all neural LMs ( p < .001 p<.001 , χ 2 ​ ( 1 ) > 846 \chi^{2}(1)>846 ; Table 3 ), indicating that surprisal captures variance in RTs beyond lexical frequency and word length. Further adding dependency length yields additional improvement ( p < .001 p<.001 ), suggesting that structural information contributes independently of surprisal. Global fit is thus robust, but as argued above, not sufficient: whether models encode the specific structural cost of subject-verb integration is the question we turn to next.

Dependency length contributes further beyond surprisal (all p < .05 p<.05 , χ 2 ​ ( 1 ) = 5 \chi^{2}(1)=5 – 11 11 ), indicating that structural distance is not fully captured by surprisal alone. At dependency length 9, neural models hold up but unevenly: most settle at r = 0.26 r=0.26 – 0.35 0.35 with wider CIs reflecting reduced power, the src < < orc verb-surprisal contrast attenuates, and no model approaches the sharp 70 ms 70\text{\,}\mathrm{ms} orc penalty humans incur at fixed linear distance (PP vs. ORC in Table 2 ), an indication that the failure is qualitative, not merely quantitative. blocks.en: Crucially, scaling within families has no consistent benefit: larger models do not fit human integration profiles better, and the largest variants lose correlation points relative to their smaller counterparts. This suggests the gap is not a matter of capacity but a structural one (e.g., inductive bias or training objective). Consistent with this, mamba-130M reaches r = 0.41 r=0.41 at dependency length 9, the only model whose CI does not overlap with any 0-word dependency interval, approaching the global baseline and outperforming larger attention-based models. This suggests that memory-constrained architectures produce integration profiles closer to human behavior, though the advantage remains modest and requires further investigation. Reader profile analyses (Appendix E ) point to a further limitation independent of architecture or scale: surprisingly, LMs fit slow and medium readers better than fast ones, who display high working-memory readers and are simultaneously faster and more accurate. The fast readers being the hardest to model suggests efficient integration strategies remain outside what surprisal captures.

blocks.zh: 5.3 预测和观察的RT比较

blocks.en: If surprisal captured the full integration cost of the dependency, a surprisal-to-RT conversion factor estimated independently should predict RT effects of the observed magnitude. Following Van Schijndel and Linzen (2021) and Huang et al. (2024) 10 10 10 Originally developed to test whether surprisal explains syntactic disambiguation difficulty. , we test this by estimating, for each model, a conversion factor (ms per bit of surprisal) on an independent corpus (Natural Stories, Futrell et al., 2021 ), regressing RT on surprisal at the current and three preceding words (spillover), word length, and log-frequency 11 11 11 Pythia-12B and KenLM_Pythia were excluded due to technical constraints. . Only four models yielded a significant spillover coefficient at p < .01 p<.01 (Mamba-130M, Pythia-70M, Pythia-1.4B, KenLM/GPT-2) and were retained as conversion factors; we applied their conversion factors to surprisal on StructuralCost critical items to obtain predicted Effects of Interest (EOIs) 12 12 12 Predicted RT minus predicted Baseline RT. .

blocks.en: 6 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en:
Our results both replicate and qualify prior work ( Futrell et al., 2021 ; Oh and Schuler, 2023 ; Shain et al., 2024 ) : global surprisal-RT alignment is robust but dominated by lexical frequency and
word length, explaining why correlations cluster at r ≈ 0.5 r\approx 0.5 regardless of parameter count, training data, or memory architecture. Any model with basic word statistics will track these signals, which is precisely why global alignment is a weak diagnostic for cognitive plausibility that does not generalize to structural difficulty. Neural models significantly improve fit at the main verb over n n -gram baselines and partially mirror the syntactic ordering of conditions, yet they underestimate how processing cost scales with dependency length. The gap persists across architectures and sizes, pointing to a specific limitation: current models appear to capture the predictive component of processing but not the memory-based integration cost that working memory imposes at structural dependencies. The one partial exception is mamba -130M, which achieves the highest verb-level correlations at long dependencies, consistent with the hypothesis that selective state-space compression introduces a recency bias that partially mimics distance-dependent memory decay.
Whether these advantages reflect genuine architectural sensitivity or confounds in training data and tokenization remains to be established.
An unexpected pattern emerges at double embedding: 2 × \times SRC and 2 × \times ORC are consistently read faster than their singly-embedded counterparts.
No model predicts this reversal. One possible explanation is within-sentence syntactic adaptation: by the second embedding, readers have already processed the relevant structure once earlier in the same sentence, potentially lowering marginal integration cost even as cumulative memory load increases. We flag this as an open question for future work rather than a settled mechanism.
Together, these findings motivate a reorientation away from global evaluation and toward controlled datasets that isolate memory-sensitive positions. On the modeling side, they favor architectural interventions that introduce explicit memory constraints such as limited context ( Kuribayashi et al., 2022 ) , recency-biased attention ( De Varda and Marelli, 2024 ; Clark et al., 2025 ) , or capacity-constrained recurrence ( Timkey and Linzen, 2023 ) over further scaling. StructuralCost provides the evaluation framework needed to test such interventions directly at the integration site.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusions
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en:
We introduced StructuralCost , a controlled self-paced reading dataset isolating the processing cost of dependency length from lexical confounds. Human reading times at the main verb increase with dependency length, driven by syntactic embedding beyond linear distance, confirming that the dataset captures memory-based difficulty.
Using StructuralCost , we evaluated LMs spanning n n -gram, SSM, and transformer architectures. Two findings emerge consistently. First, global surprisal-RT alignment is architecturally uninformative: models cluster at similar correlations regardless of architecture or scale, reflecting the dominance of lexical frequency and word length in RT variance. Second, this global alignment does not extend to structural difficulty: neural models partially mirror the graded difficulty profile at the main verb, yet underestimate the integration cost humans incur, and this gap persists across architectures and sizes.
These findings suggest that global surprisal-RT alignment is not a sufficient criterion for cognitive plausibility. Current models seem to capture the predictive component of human processing but not the memory-based integration cost. StructuralCost provides the controlled evaluation data needed to make progress on this gap.
blocks.zh:
我们引入了结构成本(Structural Cost),一个可控的自速度读取数据集将依赖长度的处理成本与词汇错解隔离开来. 主动词的人类读取时间会随着依赖长度而增加,由超出线性距离的合成嵌入所驱动,确认数据集能捕捉基于内存的难度.
我们利用结构成本评估了跨 n-gram、SSM和变压器结构的LMs。 两项调查结果始终如一地出现。 首先,全球的surprisal-RT对接在建筑学上是非入门性的:无论架构或规模大小,模型在相似的关联性上集群,反映了词汇频率和字长在RT差异中的主导地位. 其次,这种全球对接并不延伸至结构难度:神经模型部分地反映了主动词的分级难度剖面,然而低估了人类所承受的集成成本,这种差距在建筑和大小之间仍然存在.
这些调查结果表明,全球超视距调整不是认知可信度的充分标准。 目前的模型似乎能捕捉人类加工的预测成分,但不能捕捉基于内存的集成成本. 结构成本提供在弥补这一差距方面取得进展所需的控制下评价数据。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en:
StructuralCost prioritizes internal validity at the cost of ecological generalizability: sentences are controlled constructions in English only, collected online from native speakers, limiting cross-linguistic and cross-population conclusions. The online setting also means the reading environment and equipment were not controlled.
A denser condition gradient (e.g., a PP+SRC combination) would further help dissociate linear and hierarchical contributions, and would clarify the embedding-depth reversal noted in Section 6 ; we leave this to future work.
Working memory capacity scores, though collected, are not yet fully leveraged here; a fuller individual-differences analysis is a natural extension.
The 0.7 comprehension accuracy cutoff is conventional; participants just below this threshold may have been engaged readers. Due to an implementation error, the dataset only contains each participant’s overall comprehension accuracy, not their per-item comprehension results; the latter would have allowed a finer-grained comparison between reading times and comprehension accuracy at the item level.
On the modeling side, LM surprisal captures predictive processing cost but not the integration cost arising from working memory constraints: a limitation that motivates the dataset rather than undermining it but that questions nonetheless the reliability of surprisal as a complete proxy for human processing difficulty. Finally, we evaluate a representative but non-exhaustive set of architectures; other models may behave differently, and their evaluation on StructuralCost remains open.
blocks.zh:
结构 成本以生态通俗性为代价优先考虑内部有效性:句子只有英语的受控构造,在线收集来自母语者,限制了跨语言和跨人口的结论. 在线设置还意味着阅读环境和设备不受控制.
更密集的条件梯度(如PP+SRC组合)将进一步帮助分离线性贡献和分级贡献,并澄清第6节所注意到的嵌入式深度倒置;我们将此留给今后的工作。
工作记忆能力分数虽然已经收集,但在此尚未充分利用;更充分的个人差异分析是自然延伸。
0.7理解准确性截断是常规的;低于这一阈值的参与者可能是参与的读者。 由于执行错误,数据集只包含每个参与者的总体理解准确性,而不是其逐项理解结果;后者本来可以更精确地比较项目一级的阅读时间和理解准确性。
在建模方面,LM Suprisal捕捉到预测性处理成本,但不捕捉工作内存限制产生的集成成本:这种限制激励了数据集而不是破坏数据集,但对于将Suprisal作为人类处理难度的完整代名词的可靠性提出质疑. 最后,我们评价一套具有代表性但并非详尽无遗的架构;其他模式可能行为不同,它们对结构成本的评价仍然开放。

blocks.en: All critical and control sentences were subject to the following constraints during generation and manual review: • All six sentences in a set share the same main subject and main verb, with intervening words held constant or maximally similar across conditions. • Main verbs are never sentence-final to avoid spillover and end-of-sentence effect ambiguity. • Embedded nouns match the number of the main subject to prevent agreement-attraction confounds (e.g., “The babysitters PL who the children PL loved prepare the diner”). • Embedded clauses use past tense while main clauses use present tense. • All sentences are 13–15 words; shorter conditions are padded with a post-critical coordinated clause to match length (see Table 1 ). • Cloze-likely verbs were replaced to avoid predictability artifacts (e.g., “The baker bakes” or “The violinist plays” where “prepares” or “leaves” were preferred). • Each sentence was judged semantically correct and plausible by a proficient speaker.

True/false comprehension questions followed more than half (56%) of sentences to ensure active processing ( Ferreira and Yang, 2019 ) . Each participant answered 30 questions on control sentences and 20 on critical ones, with an equal number of true and false answers, ensuring consistent reading strategy across sentence types. blocks.en: B.3 Participants: recruitment and payment
blocks.zh: B.3 与会者:征聘和薪酬

blocks.en: To avoid confounding structural difficulty with proficiency effects, we restrict our analysis to native speaker data exclusively. Participants were recruited via Prolific, restricted to self-reported native English speakers with U.S. nationality or longest residence in the U.S., and no diagnosed or suspected reading disorder. The experiment lasted approximately 30 minutes and participants were compensated £5 (£10/hour, approximately $13.50/hour), consistent with Prolific’s fair pay guidelines.
blocks.zh: 为了避免结构困难与熟练程度效应相混淆,我们的分析仅限于母语数据。 参与者是通过Prolific招聘的,仅限于自报的具有美国国籍或在美国居住最久的英语母语,没有确诊或疑似阅读障碍. 实验持续了大约30分钟,参与者得到5英镑(10英镑/小时,约13.50美元/小时)的补偿,这符合普罗利克的公平薪酬准则.

blocks.en:
Before the experiment began, participants were presented with a full information letter

They provided explicit consent to participate in a study on reading times, acknowledging that no directly identifying data would be reported. Only consenting participants were admitted. Data was pseudonymized upon collection and anonymized before analysis.

blocks.en: B.7 Stimulus generation
blocks.zh: B.7 刺激发电

blocks.en:
Critical sentences were generated using the LLaMA-3.2 API ( Grattafiori et al., 2024 ) , prompting the model with a semantic domain (e.g., school , health , weather ) and grammatical number (singular/plural) , and requesting all six structural variants simultaneously with a shared subject-verb pair and maximal lexical overlap.
Control sentences were generated one set at a time using Perplexity.ai ( Perplexity AI, 2024 ) , specifying the PP-only constraint, three dependency lengths (0, 4, 9 words), and maximal lexical overlap. All items then underwent manual review for plausibility, verb predictability, number agreement, tense consistency, and length matching (13-15 words).
blocks.zh:
使用LLaMA-3.2 API(Grattafiori等,2024年)生成了临界句子,催生了具有语义域(如学校,健康,天气等)和语法号(单词/平词)的模型,并请求所有六个结构变体同时使用一个共同的主题-动词对和最大词典重叠.
控制句是一次使用Perplexity.ai(Perplexity AI, 2024)生成一个设定的,指定了仅限PP的制约,三个依赖长度(0,4,9个字),以及最大语法重叠. 然后对所有项目进行人工审查,以确定其可信度、动词可预测性、数字一致、紧张一致性和长度匹配(13至15个字)。

blocks.en: Appendix C Preprocessing
blocks.zh: 附录C 预处理

blocks.en: The first and last word of each sentence are excluded from all analyses: SPR paradigms produce elevated RTs at sentence boundaries that reflect task mechanics rather than linguistic processing. As a byproduct, this removes the beginning-of-sequence token whose surprisal is undefined or uninformative across LMs. These exclusions are applied uniformly to RT and surprisal files.
blocks.zh: 每个句子的第一个和最后一个字都被排除在所有分析之外: SPR范式在句子边界上产生能反映任务力学而非语言处理的高分RT. 作为一种副产品,这消除了序列的起步符,其后缀在LMs之间没有定义或者没有信息. 这些排除规定统一适用于RT和suprisal文件。

blocks.en: Reader profiles are computed on trimmed data: each participant’s mean RT is calculated across all retained word positions, and participants are partitioned into fast, medium, and slow profiles at the 33rd and 66th percentiles. All predictors are z-scored to make estimates comparable across datasets.
blocks.zh: 阅读器配置图是根据修剪后的数据计算出来的:每个参与者的平均RT是在所有保留字位上计算出来的,参与者在33分之和66分之中被分为快、中和慢配置图。 所有预测器均以z分计分,使各种数据集的估计数具有可比性。

blocks.en: Appendix D Dependency parsing
blocks.zh: 附录D 依赖性分析

blocks.en: Dependency length is operationalized as the linear distance in tokens between the main verb and its subject, extracted automatically via UDPipe Straka et al. (2016) using the English Universal Dependencies model Nivre et al. (2016) for UCL corpus. Natural Stories already provide parse files.
blocks.zh: 依赖性长度作为主动词与主体之间的符号线性距离被操作,通过UDPipe Straka等(2016年)自动取出,使用英国通用依赖性模型Nivre等(2016年)用于UCLecur. 自然故事已经提供了解析文件 。

blocks.en: Appendix E Reader profile alignment
blocks.zh: 附录 E 阅读器配置文件对齐

blocks.en: Human variability is non-trivial and theoretically informative. Thus we compute reader profiles on the previously trimmed data: each participant’s mean RT is calculated across all retained word positions, and participants are partitioned into fast, medium, and slow profiles based on the 33rd and 66th percentiles of this distribution. These profiles are used throughout as secondary diagnostics.
blocks.zh: 人类的可变性是非三角性的,理论上是丰富的。 因此,我们根据先前的裁剪数据计算读者简介:每个参与者的平均RT是在所有保留词位上计算出来的,参与者根据该分布的33和66百分位分为快、中和慢等剖面。 这些简介一直用作二级诊断。

blocks.en: We observe an asymmetry concerning which readers LMs approximate most closely. Contrary to the prediction that surprisal, a prediction-based signal, would align with fast, anticipation-driven readers, the opposite holds: fast readers show the lowest verb-level fit across all models ( r = 0.15 r=0.15 - 0.22 0.22 for neural models; near zero for KenLM), while medium and slow readers show consistently higher fit ( r = 0.36 r=0.36 - 0.40 0.40 ). Cognitive profiling suggests this is not an artifact of inattention: high working-memory readers are simultaneously faster and more accurate, yet the ones LMs fit least well. One interpretation is that efficient readers deploy an integration strategy that bypasses the retrieval operations surprisal tracks, a dimension of human processing that current LMs, regardless of architecture or scale, do not capture.
